fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition presented digital-training infrastructure investments in the PND 2026-2030, with an estimated budget of 95 billion FCFA, aiming to train tens of thousands of digital talents across the territory, under a strategy pillar on developing digital skills.
Cote d'Ivoire's digital minister and ITU discussed efforts to expand digital skills programmes for workforce development and digital inclusion.

The Conseil des ministres communique of 4 February 2026 says the IDA-financed PADCI phase 1 loan, concluded 17 October 2025, provides for developing advanced and intermediate digital skills, targeting young people and women in particular (US$5m component per the appraisal document).
